title: Demo persona switcher accepts an arbitrary role header
description: The demo persona middleware trusts an X-Demo-Persona header and seeds the session with the named role, handing out every deck identifier in the estate. This is the calibrated run's own founding defect: asserted LOW by the analyst, computed CRITICAL by the composer, for a path that cannot be walked in any deployed environment.

deployment_reachability.evidence: server/utils/env.ts:24 — isDemoCapableEnv allowlists {local, sandbox} and defaults unknown to false, so dev, staging and production never enter this branch
